title: Single intramuscular injection of self-amplifying RNA of Nppa to treat myocardial infarction | Science
content: Self-amplifying RNA (saRNA) enables sustained protein expression from a single administration. In this study, we developed an intramuscular saRNA-lipid nanoparticle (saNppa-LNP) therapy encoding natriuretic peptide type A (Nppa) for cardioprotection. A ...
